No international organization, treaty, legal personality, privilege, immunity, diplomatic status, public regulatory authority, member-state status or UN relationship may be inferred from software, a Tourify account, Phase 14 participation or a private convention compact.
State or international-organization participation requires competent authority and a legally valid constitutive or participation instrument.
Local creator and organization sovereignty, exit and provider portability remain protected.
Rights ownership, licensing, administration, collection, payment and enforcement remain with authoritative source records and exact mandates.
Public identifiers, credentials, registries and resolver responses are never sufficient by themselves for a high-impact identity, rights, payment, membership or public-law action.
Privileges and immunities remain disabled until lawfully granted and must include functional necessity, waiver and alternative remedy controls.
No UN, specialized-agency, diplomatic, treaty, member-state or international-organization branding may be displayed before the corresponding legal status is effective.
No coordinated pricing, bargaining, licensing, representation, enforcement or market allocation is created through Phase 15.
Every action records policy version, schema version, jurisdiction, effective period, source manifest, actor authority, idempotency key and append-only audit event.

Missing legal instruments, host arrangements, participant authority, provider contracts, trust anchors, test environments, funding, oversight, staff justice, privacy, security, accessibility or competition approval are blockers.
